title: supplier export path
question: What must be true before a sensitive supplier export is created, transferred, used, cached, printed, and confirmed deleted?
scenario: Regulated export to a supplier: A supplier needs a limited set of sensitive records for a 14-day support case.
focalRelation: Classification and purpose set need-to-know and minimum data; each transition has an approved actor, channel, location, copy rule, retention trigger, evidence, and exception path.

nodes.label: Support Purpose
nodes.detail: The supplier may use the records only to resolve the named 14-day support case.

nodes.label: Need To Know
nodes.detail: Only supplier personnel assigned to the case may receive the minimum data needed for their task.

nodes.label: Minimum Export
nodes.detail: The export removes fields and precision that are unnecessary for the support purpose.

nodes.label: Classification And Marking
nodes.detail: The organization applies the correct sensitivity label and handling markings before transfer.

nodes.label: Handling Rule
nodes.detail: The rule governs approved channel, storage, access, retention, return, and verified disposal for the export.

nodes.label: Policy Permitted Approved Exception
nodes.detail: Any variance identifies its owner, exact scope, compensating controls, review date, and end condition.

assumptions: Only entities and claims anchored in the canonical unit or explicitly labeled hypothetical scenario are used.
A highlighted path means the learner is inspecting that path; it does not assert the event occurred.
The current source is authoritative for facts; this treatment reorganizes presentation without changing canonical content.
The lesson teaches one bounded decision and does not claim to exhaust every jurisdiction, vendor implementation, architecture, attack, or exception.

treatmentDispositions.rationale: The boundary states preserve purpose, recipient, minimization, transfer, copy, retention, and verified-disposition gates for the 14-day supplier case. The handling record is expressed through state changes rather than a separately interactive day-by-day ledger.

learningJob.plainExplanation: Purpose and need-to-know constrain who may use which minimum data. Every copy and channel then inherits classification-derived transfer, storage, retention, return, and disposal rules unless a bounded exception is approved.
learningJob.visualReasoningGain: A copy-path table adds stage-by-stage custody and evidence; the current selected-edge flow makes learners reconstruct create, transfer, use, cache, print, and disposal.
